description: List the Google Drive files & folders Hermoso can reach: the ones it created plus any the user picked with the Google file picker in the app (drive.file, never their whole Drive). This is how you find a picked file's id. Filter by query (name contains …), folderId, or onlyFolders:true; paginate with pageToken. Read-only. A FOLDER: picking a folder hands over the folder alone, not its files, so a folder can list empty or partly; the reply then carries `pickUrl`, an app link that opens the picker inside that folder (Cmd+A / Ctrl+A selects every file and subfolder). Give the user that exact link, then list again. recursive:true walks every subfolder Hermoso can see (each row has its `path`) and reports picked files whose folder it cannot see.

folderId.description: list the contents of this folder id

query.description: only files whose name contains this

name: list_drive_files
title: List Google Drive files
